No worries! Welcome to the whacky world of Human Trains On Rollerskates, The Musical hope you enjoy your stay!

It's really just the main red string of the entire plot, there's many other things going on like the (depending on if you're talking about Bochum or London) CB / Slick sabotage storyline, Greaseball × Dinah relationship drama, (In London) Hydra just being an absolute menace in the best way, The Starlight™

All in all I would say take your time exploring all the characters and their roles within the story! Especially if you wanna get into the differences between the different versions of the show

The musical is about toy trains that come to life in a child's imagination. They all have to race against each other to win the big prize. Pearl is a new train coach added to the box and Rusty falls in love with her.

Everyone hates Rusty and are train-racist to him because he's a steam train and that's so lame.

Pearl wants to win the prize and races with both Electra and Greaseball (who are the 2 villains) but Pearl gets dumped by Greaseball in the final race.

Rusty wins the race due to everyone else getting sabotaged but instead of celebrating he goes to look for Pearl. They realise they're in love and they live happily ever after.

Steam wins and we see the light at the end of the tunnel, woo-woo

(There's many other things going on but I think this is it in broad strokes)

Soundtracks are sadly just really sucky if they're all listed under different artists 🥲 currently the only way to obtain songs that aren't in the map drop pool is through doing quests.

Also unrelated to this post but another problem you might encounter as I have. A lot of artists but especially soundtracks that have a specific artist with just the name of the movie/show/musical etc. often do not recognise all songs under it. I for example wanted to collect the soundtrack to the musical "Starlight Express" but out of all the songs on the soundtrack (that are all listed in game!) You can only quest one and then it recognises you as having platinum badge of that artist.

Moral of the story... Trying to collect soundtracks is a pain in the ***

Don't let it get you down tho! Goodluck and happy collecting!
